Khowai, Tripura, 11th of October, 2026 : Suranjali Cultural Troup social organization is the most prominent organization in Tripura. Suranjali Cultural Troup conducts social work and cultural events at various times across the state. They have been doing this for long 18 years.
With the initiative of Suranjali Cultural Troup social and cultural organization a vibrant cultural programme titled ‘‘Sharad Saje’’ was organized at Netaji statue premises, near Kohinoor Shopping Complex in Subhash Park, Khowai, Tripura on Sunday (11th October, 2026).
In the In the presence of many distinguished dignitaries Hon’ble Higher Education Minister Kishor Barman inaugurated the events by lighting the lamp.
Along with local artists from Khowai, renowned performers from Agartala, Dharmanagar and Bishalgarh also took part in the musical programme. The event was graced by renowned Tripura folk artist Shiuli Bhattacharya. Artists from Suranjali Cultural Troupe also enthralled the audience with their captivating performances. A souvenir was also unveiled during the programme to mark the occasion.
Amidst the distinguished dignitaries there were Khowai Municipal Council Chairperson Debashis Nath Sharma, prominent Khowai social activist Samir Kumar Das, Aparna Singha Roy, and Suranjali Cultural Troupe President Siddhartha Shankar Roy, along with other distinguished guests. The programme also featured a felicitation ceremony honouring all journalists of Khowai in recognition of their contributions.
